title: Website Audit
description: Enter any company website and get a full go-to-market diagnostic in minutes. An AI analyst reads the site and streams a 7-module report — value prop, ICP, personas, competitive position, market size, and a 90-day plan — with a maturity scorecard and prioritized moves.

title: SEO Audit
description: Enter a website URL and get a streaming technical SEO audit. A headless browser crawls and renders every page for real measurements — status codes, redirect chains, canonicals, JSON-LD, image weights — then an AI analyst applies the seo-audit v2.0.1 framework to produce scored findings with evidence and a prioritized action plan.

description: Signal-first lead discovery. Finds new leads and the cited evidence for why they're a lead right now — never surfaces a lead without a quoted source.
